Name: Absolute Executioner
Description:
An executioner's sword wreathed in spinning gears and sparking blades.

Unleashes a multi-hit downward strike.

Name: Battle Axe: Idris's Conceit
Description:
A special axe that generates a temporal force field.

Striking with the axe creates a wide-area shock wave. The axe's swing can easily break through shields, and its force field gradually builds up the slow status ailment.

Name: Bloodreaver Blade
Description: A long blade that slashes foes with a flash-draw strike.

Name: Manus Rapacis
Description:
A grotesque hand that channels the Resurgence's power into a searing beam of light.

Fires a long-range laser directly ahead in a straight line.

Name: MK Rosenritter
Description: Twin triple-barreled Gatling guns that turn a wide area into a bullet storm.

Name: Statesman's Longbow
Description: A bow that fires arrows of light at incredible speed.

Name: Warhammer of the Fool
Description:
A fire-belching hammer with three forms.

Initiates a chain of attacks starting from a heavy downward swing.

Name: Wings of Eternity
Description:
The twisted wings of Valentin, transfigured into forma.

Rains countless spears of light from above, bombarding a wide area.
